scenarios.name: Scenario 1: The 3-Hour Regional Chokepoint
scenarios.narrative: At ALJN, Train 12301 is running 24 min late. Official NTES predicts recovery down to +18 min at Kanpur Central (CNB). Frozen delay assumes it stays at +24 min. RailTwin-X models downstream yard occupancy and rake reversal buffer, predicting +38 min (p10: 31m, p90: 48m). Actual arrival at CNB is 39 min late.

scenarios.name: Scenario 2: The Outer Home Signal Failure
scenarios.narrative: A signal drop occurs at Kanpur Central outer home signal. Presenter clicks 'Inject Signal Hold (+25m)'. RailTwin-X immediately shifts p50 by +25m and widens p90 envelope, updating why-late autopsy with a live signal hold chip. Static NTES and frozen baselines stay completely unaware.

scenarios.name: Scenario 3: Connection Custody DSS at Kanpur Junction
scenarios.narrative: Feeder train #12381 is arriving late (+20m). 35 passengers have onward connection on #12314 Rajdhani. The next connecting train is 5 hours later (300 min headway). Holding #12314 by 6 min causes minor delay to onboard passengers but saves 35 passengers from being stranded, producing a net saving of +115.0 passenger-hours.

scenarios.narrative: Presenter opens the Honest Model Card and SHA-256 Ledger. Demonstrates that 1,962 prediction blocks are chained in an append-only SHA-256 hash sequence. Every prediction was sealed before arrival. Zero retroactive cherry-picking. 80.64% empirical coverage matches 80% target.
